modify_body.doc: Change a symbol's body; its name and signature stay.

signature_change.doc: Change a symbol's parameters, return type or decorators.

rename.doc: Rename a symbol in place. public.new_name replaces the last segment of the symbol, or the whole symbol path when it contains a dot.

insert.doc: Create a symbol at this key.

move.doc: Move a symbol (or a whole file) to public.new_path.

file_replace.doc: Replace a whole file: configs, lockfiles, binaries, anything without symbols.

notes.modify_body/modify_body: Two bodies: the server cannot merge text it never sees. The later writer merges locally.
notes.modify_body/signature_change: Their new parameters change what the body may use.
notes.modify_body/rename: Their rename moved the symbol; the body edit follows it to the new key.
notes.modify_body/move: Their move put the symbol in another file; the body edit follows it.
notes.signature_change/modify_body: Their body was written for the old signature.
notes.rename/modify_body: A name and a body are independent: the rename is replayed on the new body.
notes.rename/signature_change: A name and a parameter list compose when the rename is replayed as a typed op.
notes.rename/rename: Two new names for one symbol.
notes.rename/move: Their move took the symbol elsewhere; the rename follows it.
notes.insert/rename: Their rename freed this name; the new symbol takes it.
notes.insert/delete: Their delete freed this name; the new symbol takes it.
notes.insert/move: Their move freed this name; the new symbol takes it.
notes.insert/insert: Two symbols created under one name.
notes.delete/modify_body: Deleting something someone just changed: ask them first.
notes.move/modify_body: A move carries whatever body is current, so it composes with an edit.
notes.move/rename: Their rename moved the key; the move follows it.
notes.file_replace/move: The file moved; the replacement follows it.
